ModMetaData.name: Cat Mortar
ModMetaData.author: konduct
ModMetaData.description: A cat-themed artillery mortar that loads one colony cat, cat corpse, or up to 20 cat meat. Living cats gain a random launch coat with a devastating follow-up effect; corpses create a weaker toxic-gas barrage; cat meat auto-reloads and scatters into small bloody direct-hit chunks across a 7-tile area.
